context: Peppy's cart, the Bryant Park edge of 42nd St.

lines.speaker: npc.cart_vendor
lines.text: Salt or no salt? Tip's free if you carry my propane up from Sixth.

lines.speaker: npc.cart_vendor
lines.text: There's a door on Forty-First nobody locks. Roof, water tank, the works.

lines.speaker: npc.cart_vendor
lines.text: Tell the other carts Peppy says you're okay. Now we all watch for you.
